queries_run: Twilio distribution channel shift go-to-market change 2026
Twilio business model transition platform pricing 2026

findings.claim: Twilio 10-K FY2025 describes strategy of consolidating into one platform combining communications channels, contextual data and AI orchestration, with pre-built solutions and cross-channel orchestration (platform consolidation, no D2C/channel disintermediation described).
findings.excerpt: Our strategy is rooted in streamlining our platform and delivering a trusted, intuitive customer experience.

findings.claim: Futurum summary of Q1 FY2026: Twilio described go-to-market changes combining account executive coverage with specialist motions, plus enablement/compensation to drive cross-sell of software add-ons (Verify, ConversationRelay); self-serve and ISV cohorts grew 25%+ YoY.
findings.source: Futurum Group, Twilio Q1 FY 2026 Earnings Show Accelerating Voice and Messaging Demand

channel_business_model_shift.note: No evidence of structural channel disintermediation or D2C shift; core remains usage-based with subscription/software add-ons layered on. Futurum date approximate. Third-party tracker noted an April 2026 pricing plan restructuring, unverified.

clues.claim: Third-party tracker reports Twilio restructured pricing plans (Free Trial, Pay-as-You-Go, Enterprise) in April 2026.
